name: Tartaros Sandbox
placement: Casual play · Perfect for new or returning players
card_quote: "I'm new to CT, I want to learn the ropes or just want to test out the event."
card_desc: → Sandbox is suited just for you. No requirements, people to help you out, and a place to learn how to CT. Zero pressure — just play.
modal_quote: "I'm new to CT, I want to learn the ropes or just want to test out the event."
modal_desc: Sandbox is exactly what it sounds like — a safe space to play, experiment, and learn without any expectations hanging over you. If you've never done CT before, or you've been away from it for a while, or you just want a chill home base while you figure things out, Sandbox is where you start. Friendly people, zero pressure, and plenty of help available whenever you want it.
requirements: No requirements — seriously, just join and play at your own pace
Be respectful — that's the only rule that really matters here
Curious attitude — ask questions, try things, learn at whatever pace feels right
Sandbox doubles as the starting point for players being evaluated for higher team placement
